item.tib: pad ma thugs kyi rtsa rgyud las glu ru drag po rdo rje gur khang klu 'dul khyung gi bsgrubs pa
item.coloph: de ltar gsang ba sngags kyi yang snying bon/ klu 'dul drag po khyung gi sgrub pa 'di/ slob dpon chen po'i thugs kyi bcud nas/ ye shes mtsho rgyal dgongs pa'i mdzod bskul te/ dus mtha'i rnal 'byor mi shig rdo rje rtsal/ nges med sprang po bdag la snyan du brgyud/ bdag gis sbas dang gsang rgya thub par byas/ dad ldan rkyen bskul dper phab 'di/ yi dam dbal khyung lha la mthol/ bka' skyong bstan srung rnams la bzod par gsol/ dge ba'i 'gro kun rnam mkhyen sa thob shog/
